[[Headache Headquarters|{{Color|Toilet}}]] |first_wave_appearance = N/A |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]50 |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Slightly Fast (5.35) |spawned_by = [[Png Bot2]] |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None }} ==Description== The '''Png Bot''' was an enemy that appeared in [[Headache Headquarters]]. It did not appear naturally and is instead spawned by the [[Png Bot2]]. Currently, it only appears when the [[Brain Rot]] modifier is activated in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, replacing every modern [[Breaker]] variant, or with its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]. It has a decent amount of health and a quite fast speed. ==Appearance== The '''Png Bot''' is a two-dimensional enemy that has multiple appearances. All of them are various images of cats, some of them being memes and other images of the developer's cats. ==Headache Headquarters Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Headache Headquarters]] is listed instead. *Strong early-game towers like the [[Brawler]], [[Golden Scout]] or [[Golden Crook Boss]] are very effective here. **Towers with area of effect capabilities, like the [[Electroshocker]] or [[Mortar]], can also be useful here. **Stalling towers, like the [[Cryomancer]], [[Freezer]] or [[Frost Blaster]], can also be useful, due to the '''Png Bot2's''' speed. *High DPS towers like the [[Minigunner]] and [[Accelerator]] can be useful against this. *The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be useful at boosting the firerate and range of your towers respectively. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1Png1.png|Green DefaultEnemyIconIG.png|'''Png Bot''' on its bugged [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *This enemy is a reference to [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/subcultures/nextbot-chase-garrys-mod NextBots] that originated from ''Garry's Mod''. These are images that would chase the player, killing them when touched. **All of the images that appear here are cats. Multiple of them are memes, with these being: ***[https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/maxwell-the-cat-spinning-cat Jess], more commonly known as Maxwell the cat. ***[https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/uncanny-cat Canny and Uncanny cat]. ***[https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/sad-banana-cat Sad cat in a banana suit]. ***[https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/happy-happy-happy-cat Happy Cat] jumping up and down. ***[https://www.reddit.com/r/MemeTemplatesOfficial/comments/n9rw4c/fat_cat_withwithout_suit/ Fat cat in a tuxedo]. ***An image of a cat with its mouth open, which is commonly posted alongside a "'':D''" caption on a white background. ***A cropped image of [https://imgur.com/a/AfzIhnS this cat]. **Most other cats are the Tower Defense Simulator developer's cats. ***One of them has been confirmed to belong to StarWarshttps://discord.com/channels/587355301083349002/587355301674614854/1238161449847754894.
